title: Fusion Sports Tournament 2027
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 421 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
The requested budget of INR 81,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Sports Tournament.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
